items.source:
Synthetic advisor that instantiates the aspect.
Triggered by per-clause pointcut on non-singleton aspect.
The advice has no effect.
items.translation:
合成顾问，用于实例化切面。
由非单例切面的每条子句点切入触发。
该建议无效。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Adrian Colyer, Juergen Hoeller, Ramnivas Laddad, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen
